The tallest is Ante Zizic at 210 cm. The youngest is Yagiz Aksu (born 2006) and the most experienced Anthony Brown (born 1992). Beyond Turkey, the squad draws most on USA (6), Canada (1) and Croatia (1). Yagiz Aksu is back for another spell at the club.
